7. **Data Breaches**: If an organization's personal information has been breached, attackers can use this information to gain access to social media profiles and other online accounts of individuals.

Proxies and Tor are tools that can help mask your IP address and encrypt your online traffic. Use proxies and Tor to hide your online activities from prying eyes.

### 6. Use Anonymous Email Providers
